method: Independent model first-author renderings of 80 individually selected self-contained Spanish Wiktionary lexical meanings, written from the exact retained source definitions. Original model English, not source-provided English quotations, example sentences, native-human certification or universal Mexican usage. Submitted for independent exact-proposal review; no production data or code changed.
scope: Direct lexical noun batch only. Every selected spelling remains missing under frozen J audit; prior 81 proposals and known source-quality holds excluded. No generated morphological family, opaque synonym, form-of, alias, media, quotation or example authority.
